label: Escalation
text: ST.O.A3.3 — Escalation as a bounded, stepped structure (M19) [kahn-c04], [kaplan-c09], [soc-c08], with its limit [freedman_strategists-c19]. Measures of escalation [kahn-c05]. The nuclear/conventional threshold as symbolic [soc-c10]. The nuclear taboo [arms-c09], [arms-c10]. No reliable threshold below the nuclear boundary [future_of_war-c10]. Below-threshold and grey-zone competition [buchanan-c02], [future_of_war-c01].

warrant.standard: Thresholds identified in advance and respected in cases.
warrant.defeaters: The ladder metaphor misleads [freedman_strategists-c19]; thresholds shift with technology.
